name: nnnorm_prod_le_of_le
result.signature: (s : Finset ι) {f : ι → E} {n : ι → ℝ≥0} (h : ∀ b ∈ s, ‖f b‖₊ ≤ n b) : ‖∏ b ∈ s, f b‖₊ ≤ ∑ b ∈ s, n b
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) {f : ι → E} {n : ι → NNReal},
  (∀ b ∈ s, ‖f b‖₊ ≤ n b) → ‖∏ b ∈ s, f b‖₊ ≤ ∑ b ∈ s, n b
result.informal_name: Norm of a Sum is Less Than or Equal to the Sum of Bounds
result.informal_description:
Let $E$ be a seminormed commutative group. For a finite set $s$, let $f$ be a function from elements of $s$ to $E$, and $n$ be a function from elements of $s$ to the non-negative real numbers $\mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}$. If for every $b \in s$, we have the bound $\lVert f(b) \rVert \le n(b)$, then the norm of the sum is bounded by the sum of the bounds:
$$ \left\lVert \sum_{b \in s} f(b) \right\rVert \le \sum_{b \in s} n(b). $$

name: norm_sum_le
result.signature: {E} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → E) : ‖∑ i ∈ s, f i‖ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_9} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → E),
  ‖∑ i ∈ s, f i‖ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖
result.informal_name: Triangle Inequality for Finite Sums in Seminormed Abelian Groups
result.informal_description: For any seminormed additive commutative group $E$, finite set $s$ of indices, and function $f : s \to E$, the norm of the sum of $f(i)$ over $i \in s$ is less than or equal to the sum of the norms of $f(i)$ over $i \in s$. Mathematically, this is expressed as $\left\| \sum_{i \in s} f(i) \right\| \leq \sum_{i \in s} \|f(i)\|$.

result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {ε : Type u_8} [inst : TopologicalSpace ε] [inst_1 : ESeminormedAddCommMonoid ε] (s : Finset ι)
  {f : ι → ε} {n : ι → ENNReal}, (∀ b ∈ s, ‖f b‖ₑ ≤ n b) → ‖∑ b ∈ s, f b‖ₑ ≤ ∑ b ∈ s, n b
result.informal_name: Extended Norm of Sum is Bounded by Sum of Extended Norms
result.informal_description: For any finite set $ S $, a function $ f : S \to \varepsilon $ where $ \varepsilon $ is a seminormed additive commutative monoid, and a function $ n : S \to [0, \infty] $, if for all $ b \in S $ the extended norm $ \|f(b)\|_e \leq n(b) $, then the extended norm of the sum $ \left\|\sum_{b \in S} f(b)\right\|_e $ is less than or equal to the sum $ \sum_{b \in S} n(b) $.

result.informal_name: Triangle Inequality for Finite Sums in Seminormed Additive Commutative Groups
result.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $, a function $ f : s \to E $ into a seminormed additive commutative group $ E $, and a function $ n : s \to \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0} $, if $ \|f(b)\|_+ \leq n(b) $ for all $ b \in s $, then $ \left\|\sum_{b \in s} f(b)\right\|_+ \leq \sum_{b \in s} n(b) $.

result.informal_name: Norm of Sum Bounded by Sum of Bounds in Seminormed Group
result.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ of type $ \iota $, functions $ f : \iota \to E $ and $ n : \iota \to \mathbb{R} $, and a seminormed additive commutative group $ E $, if $ \|f(b)\| \leq n(b) $ for all $ b \in s $, then $ \left\| \sum_{b \in s} f(b) \right\| \leq \sum_{b \in s} n(b) $.
